chinese: 玛丽，慢点！请不要在走廊里奔跑。
english: Mary, slow down! Don’t run in the hallway, please.
I’m sorry! I don’t want to be late.

chinese: 莎莉，你知道规定的。校服只能在学校穿。
english: Sally, you know the rules. You can only wear the uniform at school.

chinese: 你不能在这里穿那件夹克。
english: You can’t wear that jacket here.
Why is there a bottle here?

chinese: 哦！对不起，布朗老师。对不起。
托尼，你知道你绝不能乱扔垃圾。我们必须保持学校干净整洁。
english: Tony, you know you mustn’t litter. We have to keep the school clean and tidy.
